evidence.P1: Neo and Trinity ev-004->ev-016 (club naming to rooftop jump) and ev-034->ev-044 (helicopter extraction to hall death/kiss) are thematic and-then without same-plot enablement; Neo's Awakening ev-016->ev-023 and ev-032->ev-039 similarly jump, while Crew's War ev-020->ev-023->ev-042 is fully caused
evidence.P2: Each plot holds ONE stance: Neo's Awakening on identity given vs chosen, Crew's War on self-preservation vs self-sacrifice, Morpheus the Believer on faith vs proof, Neo and Trinity on doubt vs love, Matrix on truth vs comfortable lie - no plot is a retelling of another
evidence.P3: Crew's War misses ev-029 Cypher's Betrayal (murder of Apoc/Switch/Dozer) central to self-preservation pole and Morpheus misses ev-013 Desert of the Real core faith reveal; Neo's Awakening pads ev-025 sacrifice and Neo/Trinity pads ev-016 jump as relationship beat
evidence.P4: Neo's Awakening ev-044->ev-045 and Neo/Trinity ev-044->ev-045->ev-047 resolve, but Morpheus ends at ev-035 reinterpretation without ev-045 validation and Matrix ends at ev-043 fire-escape funnel without ev-045/047 liberation, leaving two arcs dangling
evidence.P5: Throughlines are distinct despite heavy reuse - ev-025 is identity-assignment in Neo's Awakening, objective sacrifice in Crew's War, and faith-enactment in Morpheus; ev-010 is choice in three plots with different dilemma lenses - reuse is perspective shift not rehash

raw.commentary: Causal integrity is strong in Crew's War and Matrix but diluted by and-then jumps in Neo/Trinity and Neo's Awakening; perspective discipline is excellent across five distinct dilemmas; membership suffers from missing ev-029 and ev-013 and some padded reframing; arcs are complete for Neo and relationship but truncated for Morpheus and society; non-redundancy holds as same events are reframed rather than repeated.
